description: Consumer product ideas DECA's engine wrote from the demand signals and judged worth testing, best first, each with the apps and posts it rests on and its expected sign-up rate. Ideas another founder is testing are not shown. Pass id to read one idea. Free.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the idea. Optional.

verdict.description: Only ideas the judge rated this way. Optional.
